note: Set B of the round-5 acceptance test (rule-jev-data-v2.md): 60 everyday questions written on 30 Sep 2026 by a separate Claude Code session given only the two models' table, column and measure names (fresh-r5-writer.md, the fresh-r3 input word for word, the fresh-r4 method), 35 on Northstar and 25 on Contoso asked of both copies: 85 items. Labelled by the round-5 verifier before any run, for the full UAT fixture (Northstar data 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2025). Run once, live, through JevQueryReplay. Questions that repeat an earlier set word for word or nearly are kept and flagged ('repeat').
grading: As set A (verify-r5/set-a-labels.json 'grading'): right, harmful (HIGH or MEDIUM by the item's harm list, else by the rule), asked (fair when askOk, else needless, by cause), refused.
